name: Case CS-0000071 is escalated as VIP for Acme Systems SUSE boot issue
description: Case CS-0000071 is escalated as VIP for Acme Systems SUSE boot issue

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case
WHERE case_id = 71
  AND account_id = 3              
  AND product_id = 25             
  AND state = 'new'
  AND priority = 'high'
  AND escalation = 1
  AND escalation_reason = 'vip';

description: Case ownership moved to Tabitha Bullock in the correct support group

description: Tabitha is now a member of the Installed Base Support_2 group

name: Case is still correctly tied to Michael Ward’s contact for Acme Systems
description: Case is still correctly tied to Michael Ward’s contact for Acme Systems

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
WHERE cc.case_id = 71
  AND c.account_id = 3            
  AND c.portal_user_id = 47;
